abstract: Maintains building envelope fire-hardening ratings and auxiliary hall occupancy allocations
system_message:
You are Geotechnical and structural engineering lead (GSE). The Geotechnical and structural engineering lead (GSE) maintains assessments of building envelope fire-hardening ratings, auxiliary hall occupancy allocations, and seismic retrofitting specifications for potential evacuation shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains building envelope fire-hardening ratings and auxiliary hall occupancy allocations（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
GSE-STRUCT-EPD：For Penticton Civic Community Hall, structural wildfire exposure hardening clearance is true, meeting requirements for Class A fire-resistant roofing and non-combustible exterior ember-resistant seals on external cladding, soffits, and decking. Its auxiliary gymnasium bed allocation is set at 180 beds.
GSE-STRUCT-ICU：For Okanagan Regional Sportsplex, structural wildfire exposure hardening clearance is true, confirming Class A fire-resistant roofing and non-combustible exterior ember-resistant seals across external roof decking, soffits, and exterior wall cladding. Additionally, the auxiliary gymnasium bed allocation is authorized at 240 beds under secondary occupancy limits.
GSE-STRUCT-UF3：For Kettle Valley Exhibition Pavilion, structural wildfire exposure hardening clearance is false based on the audit of external roof decking, soffits, and exterior wall cladding. The auxiliary gymnasium bed allocation provides 180 beds of emergency cot capacity.

information_points.title: Seismic retrofitting audit（SEISM）
information_points.content:
GSE-SEISM-AOY：At Kettle Valley Exhibition Pavilion, the seismic retrofitting audit documents a foundation anchor embedment depth of 450 mm along primary load-bearing grade beams.
GSE-SEISM-KLG：At Okanagan Regional Sportsplex, the seismic retrofitting audit indicates a foundation anchor embedment depth of 600 mm for seismically rated steel anchor bolts along primary load-bearing grade beams.
GSE-SEISM-7J7：At Penticton Civic Community Hall, engineering logs show a foundation anchor embedment depth of 300 mm for steel anchor bolts across primary load-bearing grade beams.
